lines.text: Paul, an apostle sent by Jesus Christ and God the Father, writes to the churches of Galatia.
Jesus gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age.
Paul is amazed at how slowly the Galatians are turning to a different gospel.
Paul says that if we or a prophet from heaven preach a contrary gospel, let him be cursed.
Paul says that if he were still trying to please men, he would not be a servant of Christ.
